root_cause.text: In the mt76 mt7925 driver, mt7925_tx_check_aggr() dereferenced the ieee80211_sta pointer via sta->link[wcid->link_id] before validating that sta was non-NULL, causing a NULL pointer dereference when sta was absent.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds `if (!sta) return;` before `link_sta = rcu_dereference(sta->link[wcid->link_id]);` and removes the later `!sta` check from `if (!sta || !(link_sta->ht_cap.ht_supported || link_sta->he_cap.has_he))`, showing the original bug was using `sta` before checking it.

intent_record.how: At runtime, this prevents dereferencing a NULL `sta` pointer when accessing `sta->link[...]`, avoiding a potential crash, while preserving the existing behavior of returning early when the station lacks HT or HE capability.
